name: Update Notifier
description: Tells when a newer build of Numen is published

options.title: Stable
options.detail: Releases made once they are tested

options.title: Beta
options.detail: Builds published ahead of the next release

settings.title: Release feed address
settings.description: Address of the latest.json file to ask for the newest build. Empty asks the published feed of the channel, https://dl.numen.md/latest/latest.json for the stable channel

settings.title: Check interval
settings.description: Hours between two checks for a newer build
